scope: Reported sketch commit visibility delay and jumpy live drawing dimensions
causes: An empty sketch curve/point gizmo group allocated a new asset on the first primitive; its first completed idle frame omitted that asset.
Floating drawing readout controls and their painted backgrounds consumed CursorMoved, pausing the preview while the pointer crossed the previous readout position.
changes: Retain sketch curve, point outline and point assets with the existing invisible zero-length sentinel.
Mark drawing readouts as motion passthrough in the shared hit registry and sketch preview handler, retaining click capture, keyboard editing, wheel ownership, clipping, panel and document guards.

validation.before_fix: Metal completed frame contained no rectangle after commit; the new regression failed its immediate-visibility assertion.
validation.after_fix: Metal pixel regression passes 13 primitive variants, including both rectangle modes, line, midpoint line, point, both circle modes, both arcs, all three slots and spline. First completed pixels equal a later forced frame, with Undo between primitives and no pointer events.
validation.scale: Equal screen displacements keep the same model displacement before and after a large move for every dimensioned tool. Drawing does not change the camera.
validation.formatting: Touched Rust files and git diff whitespace check passed.

ci: Native sketch visual workflow explicitly runs the sketch-commit GPU suite; inventory rejects a missing, renamed or duplicate test.
qualification_limits: Native GPU checks are windowless and use real Metal rendering; they do not qualify physical input or the complete GUI.
No live user document or recovery data was changed.
Broader UI and manual MCP qualification stays paused; existing coverage statuses and receipts are retained.
User acceptance of the separate test application is required before marking the PR ready.
